cohort: 11,528 pregnant women with urolithiasis out of a cohort of 13,792,544 pregnant women who delivered between 1999 and 2015 in the United States
finding: Pregnant women with urolithiasis have an increased risk of adverse pregnancy and newborn outcomes, including preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, cesarean delivery, and congenital anomalies.
mod_finding: The study found that women with urolithiasis in pregnancy had a higher likelihood of delivering by cesarean section compared to those without urolithiasis.
